scope: Corollary A.1 of the manuscript “Universal strong Kadison–Kastler stability” (preprints/Universal-strong-Kadison-Kastler-stability-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 289 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e801d4ed2d8c928), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 66. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every ε > 0 there is δ > 0, independent of the algebras, their representations, and their Hilbert spaces, such that unital von Neumann algebras M, N ⊆ B(H) with the same identity and d(M, N) < δ satisfy dcb(M, N) < ε, d(M′ , N′ ) < ε.
